summary: Our latest Bathroom Inspiration Guide shows you how to create a contemporary daily retreat.
title: Get The Look - Collection Three
bodyHtml:
Modern Escape!

Hello Bathroom Enthusiast,

It’s getting harder to step away from our busy lives these days. The rise of the digital age has definitely made us more efficient, but at the same time has made it harder to peel away from our screens (and of course from our work), to allow ourselves to go into much needed respite. 
 
Creating an enclosed space where we can achieve some well deserved me time is now more crucial than ever. This is where a well designed bathroom can provide moments of peaceful solitude - a modern day retreat if you will.

Our latest Get The Look features all the elements required to create your own private day spa - We’ve introduced a range of natural textures, from the gorgeous timber vanity, to the large format stone tiles, and a striking black marble tiled floor. The soft downlight creates a peaceful ambience, and the touches of matte black invokes a sense of contemporary sophistication.
